# The kinds of tile levels spawn (MatchThreeLevelSpawns.txt says which level has which).
# CATEGORY: 0 collectable (600 + TYPE: falls into the drop zone), 1 bonus (700 + TYPE, a gem), 2 selectable (400 + TYPE: chained),
# 3 powerup (900 + TYPE: 0 time freeze, 50 dynamite, 51 wild tiles, 52 destruct, 53 shuffle), 4 loot drop (1000 + TYPE).
# SPAWNCHANCE weighs it against its category. A QUOTA makes the level need that many collected (a bin in the movie);
# a selectable or collectable with no quota and REQUIRED_PER_REWARD 0 gets no bin. Bonuses always get one.
# DURATION is a powerup's seconds, POWER its tiles. CREATE_/COLLECT_MAXIMUM 0 are no limit.
# Selectable art: mining, forging and Goo'd Candy 1-5, mail 1-8, artifacts 1-11, crops 1-16. Collectables: mining
# 0-14 (Iron, Tin, Silver, Gold, Copper; low, medium, high quality), forging 0-27 (forged item kinds), Goo'd Candy 0.
#ID^CATEGORY^TYPE^SPAWNCHANCE^CREATE_MAXIMUM^COLLECT_MAXIMUM^QUOTA^REWARDSET^ICONID^DURATION^POWER^REQUIRED_PER_REWARD^COLLECTION_TYPE^TIMER_ID^
